description: This Kotlin source file defines an in-memory fallback implementation of a Room database for Android. It provides in-memory DAO implementations for profile, connection, and transfer history data, enabling the app to operate without an actual database, typically used as a fallback.

classes.name: InMemoryAppDatabase
classes.description: In-memory fallback implementation of the Room database, providing DAO methods and no-op database helper.

classes.name: InMemoryConnectionDao
classes.description: In-memory implementation of ConnectionDao, managing ConnectionEntity items via MutableStateFlow.

classes.name: InMemoryTransferHistoryDao
classes.description: In-memory implementation of TransferHistoryDao, managing TransferHistoryEntity items via MutableStateFlow.

methods.name: createInvalidationTracker
methods.description: Provides a no-op InvalidationTracker, since in-memory database does not support invalidation.

methods.name: createOpenHelper
methods.description: Returns a no-op SupportSQLiteOpenHelper since there is no actual SQLite database.

methods.name: clearAllTables
methods.description: Clears all in-memory tables by resetting DAOs.
